judgmentMethod: Independent final blind validation, authored by a separate agent after reading only the two earlier fixtures to exclude their query/food/restaurant families, raw USDA and restaurant source JSON, and read-only canonical foods rows in mobile/assets/catalog.sqlite. No implementation, earlier benchmark reports, FTS queries or ranking output were inspected before labels were frozen. This is one fresh 40-query sample with source-grounded labels fixed before evaluation; no human ratings, random sample or user-population inference is claimed. Food families denote the same named food/item across spelling and preparation variants, not entire nutritional groups such as all vegetables or all cheese types. Known canonical alternatives with the same stated intent were included before any run. No queries, labels or engine changes may be selected from this validation outcome.
freezeRule: SHA-256 is sent to the coordinating agent before running search. Run the frozen fixture exactly once only after the coordinating agent confirms engine frozen. Report all outcomes without further tuning or label changes.
